raw_html: [[Deadly Spider Venom]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Deadly Spider Venom]]:''' This item is steeped in deadly spider venom. On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit it will inflict the target with a poison that deals 10d6 poison damage every 2 seconds for 6 seconds. When the poison wears off, it also deals 3d6 Constitution damage to the target. A successful [[Fortitude save]] (DC 34) negates the Constitution damage.
